Payment of Traffic Contraventions

Go
Search eServices, Information, Ministries ...

View and pay traffic contraventions.

Click here for Instructions

  • General Instructions
  • Traffic Contraventions

General Instructions

  • Please select the method of retrieving the contraventions.
  • Please enter the required details then click on "Continue".
  • All the traffic contraventions recorded against the specified vehicle will be displayed, regardless of whether they were committed by the vehicle owner or by a different driver.
  • In case "Driver Details" option was selected, only the contraventions committed by the user involving vehicles under his ownership will be displayed.

Traffic Contraventions

  • You can view the details of traffic contraventions through the service and proceed with the online payment.
  • In case of court transferred contraventions, you may proceed for payment once the verdict is issued throughPayment of Criminal Orders Serviceavailable on eGovernment Portal Bahrain.bh or by visiting the General Directorate of Traffic (GDT) for settlement.

* indicates the required fields.

Traffic Contravention Details

Visitor eKey

The Visitor eKey offers a low level of security as it is not based on Bahrain’s National Smartcard.

Standard eKey

The Standard eKey ensures guaranteed security. Users only need to enter their Personal Number/ National ID and Password to benefit from a range of basic eServices.

Advanced eKey

The Advanced eKey offers a higher level of security. By entering your Personal Number/ National ID and Password, you can benefit from a complete range of eServices. Registration only requires user’s Identity card and fingerprint scan.

CorpPass

Allows business owners to register their organization and employees for a CorpPass account and perform various transactions on behalf of the organization in a secure manner.
